what: Several photos follow an ellipse centered on the panel, panel width/2.4 wide · panel height/2.7 tall, about 19 seconds (angle = Makes one full turn in time/3). Rolling the wheel over the board speeds it up by as much as you roll (speed = deltaY/800 over .3s power1) each photo has a fixed share (-.25~.25) that scatters the orbit radius and tilts it (deltaY/40 over .6s power1, tilt = share × scatter × 20°). After the wheel stops, both return to 0 after .12s. Dragging with a finger works the same (deltaY/200 · /10). Stops when the panel is off screen

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Stone photos (several, required) — stacked at the plate center, the part places them in orbit
options.rx: Horizontal radius = Panel width / rx, default 2.4
options.ry: Vertical radius = Panel height / ry, default 2.7
options.period: Angle = Time (sec) / period, default 3 — larger is slower
options.accel: Divide wheel deltaY into speed, default 800
options.spread: Split wheel deltaY into scatter, default 40

note: The original sets the ellipse from the screen size. The part sets it from the panel size, so making the panel the screen height gives the same result. Finger dragging does not block page scroll (passive)
